Retirement & Savings

🏛️NPSPlan your National Pension System contributions and estimate your retirement corpus with 80CCD tax benefits.→🏦PPFTrack your Public Provident Fund deposits and see the 15-year maturity value with tax-free compounding.→🧾EPFProject your Employee Provident Fund balance at retirement, including employer contributions.→👧SSYEstimate the maturity value of a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account for your daughter’s future.→

Investments

📈Mutual FundCompare SIP and lumpsum mutual fund returns side by side.→💹SIPSee how monthly SIP investments grow over time with the power of compounding.→📶Step-Up SIPModel a SIP that increases every year and compare it against a flat, regular SIP.→💰LumpsumProject the future value of a one-time lumpsum investment.→📤SWPPlan systematic withdrawals from your corpus and check how long it will last.→

Deposits
